name.text: Finding Volume of a solid enclosed in a given region

questiontext.text:
Find the volume of the solid S obtained by revolving around the y-axis the region enclosed by \(y ={@func_y@} \) and \({@func_xy@}\).

The height of a cylindrical shell for this solid is the difference of the top curve and the bottom curve.(Note: Give your answer to \((3 dp)\))

Give your answer in 3 decimal places.

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

Find the volume of the solid S obtained by revolving around the y-axis the region enclosed by \(y ={@func_y@} \) and \({@func_xy@}\).

The height of a cylindrical shell for this solid is the difference of the top curve and the bottom curve.

[[jsxgraph]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-1, {#const+2#} , {#const+2#} , -1], keepaspectratio: true, showCopyright: false, axis: true, showNavigation: false }); // Define the functions for y = 3 + 2x - x^2 and x + y = 3 // Define the function y = 3 + 2x - x^2 var function1 = board.create('functiongraph', [function (x) {return {#const#}+{#coeff_x*x#}-{#x#}**2; }],{ name: '{#y=const+coeff_x*x-x^2#}', withlabel: true, strokeColor: 'red' }); var function2 = board.create('functiongraph', [function (x) {return {#const#} - {#1/denom#}x; }],{ name: '{#y=const-1/denom*x#}', withlabel: true, strokeColor: 'blue' }); [[/jsxgraph]]

We find the volume of the solid by using the formula below

\(\begin{align} V&=\displaystyle \int_{0}^{{@ulim@}}2\pi x(f(x)-g(x))dx\\ &=2\pi\displaystyle \int_{0}^{{@ulim@}} x({@func_y@}-({@new_func_xy@}))dx\\ &=2\pi\displaystyle \int_{0}^{{@ulim@}} x({@sol1@})dx\\ &=2\pi\displaystyle \int_{0}^{{@ulim@}} ({@sol2@})dx\\ \end{align}\)

Integrating the previous function with respect to \(x\), we have

\(\begin{align} 2\pi\displaystyle \int_{0}^{{@ulim@}} ({@sol2@})dx&= 2\pi \displaystyle \left [ {@sol_int@} \right ]_{0}^{{@ulim@}}\\ &=2\pi({@sol3@})\\ &={@sol4@}\\ \end{align}\)

Therefore the volume of the solid is \(\displaystyle {@ta@}\)
